text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Spot on! As expected of you, Trainer, 
totally nailed it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It went exactly as predicted! As long as I 
beat Shakur, the outcome was more than 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City claims the Satsuki Sho. Her 
breakthrough power has already shone 
brightly on the Classic Triple Crown 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks, Shakur! If it wasn't for your 
strength, I wouldn't have been able to run 
like this today."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you feel it too, right? This 
heat... so intense you wouldn't even 
regret losing!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't feel a damn thing!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What are you gonna do about this?! If I 
lose here, that 'fateful 7cm' won't mean 
jack shit!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, how infuriating... Losing was due to 
my own miscalculation, but what the hell 
is with you guys...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see. If you've been charmed by our way 
of doing things...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them were completely out of 
sync to the very end. Yet Tap Dance City 
looked like she was having a wonderful 
time.
